name: B10-0409/2026 (PfE) – Political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro, both jailed in Cuba, and of all political prisoners there. It asks the European Commission to end the EU's cooperation agreement with Cuba using its termination clause, and to stop sending EU money through Cuban authorities. It also asks EU governments to impose sanctions on Cuban leaders, naming Miguel Díaz-Canel and several security and military bodies.

- The EU is asked to end its cooperation agreement with Cuba and stop funding through Cuban authorities.
- Sanctions are requested against Cuban leaders, including Miguel Díaz-Canel and security bodies.
- The Parliament demands the release of the Navarro father and daughter and all political prisoners.
